results.content: # Trump approval ticks up as GOP trails before midterms: poll. After weeks of record lows stretching back to late September, President Donald Trump's approval rating ticked up slightly, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos poll. The poll, released on Oct. 26, found Trump’s approval at 32%, up one percentage point from last week's Reuters/Ipsos tracking, when his approval rating hit a record low across his White House terms. The latest Reuters/Ipsos poll gives Democrats an 11-point advantage, down 1 point from the previous week’s record high. results.content: # Trump approval sinks to new low in Fox News poll. President Donald Trump's approval rating has fallen to a new low in Fox News polling, as voters express deep dissatisfaction with his handling of inflation and the economy and Democrats widen their advantage ahead of November's midterm elections. The survey, released Oct. 14, found Trump's approval rating at 36%, while 64% of registered voters said they disapproved of his job performance. According to Fox News, that marks the lowest approval rating the president has received in the network's polling during either of his two terms in the White House.
